Scope Context controls how users interact with multi-company, multi-cost-center environments.

bilingual_registry.notes: Staged registry. States: planned (field may be absent — Arabic field/adapter/UAT pending; identity_section and tree stay disabled until each DocType clears UAT; Project does not inherit Account-style tree behavior), schema_installed (field exists, values not populated), active (display/search enabled). A missing later-wave field must not prevent app startup. Physical-field adapters resolve the arabic_field against live metadata; unresolved fields degrade silently.

unicode_policy.canonical_reference: C1: bidi controls (U+202A-U+202E, U+2066-U+2069, U+200E, U+200F, U+061C) are forbidden in stored Arabic values. Section 8.6 of the handoff permits legitimate direction marks only in unrestricted narrative fields (documented here); embeddings/overrides/isolates are forbidden everywhere.
unicode_policy.rationale: Identity/name fields (stored Arabic values) reject every bidi control. Narrative fields (rename reasons) reject NUL/C0/DEL/C1 and the embedding/override/isolate controls, while allowing the documented direction marks.
